definitions.exec: Whole host aenv exec command; includes guest runner and commands, not pure API overhead
definitions.exec_minus_command: Exec duration minus saved guest command durations; includes boundary sampling, runner setup, API/client and scheduling
definitions.download: Whole host aenv download command, including packaging, transport, extraction and CLI work
definitions.gap: Path marker to final download minus serial exec/download; includes controller work and dispatch/recording delays
definitions.matching: One-to-one causal assignment: prior download end <= exec start; exec end <= own download start; no nearest-time rule
definitions.bounds: Per-path min/max sums enclose every feasible matching; dependent path bounds must not be summed
definitions.clock: Host event monotonic clock for windows; guest duration sums only, no host/guest absolute-clock subtraction

source_evidence.boundary_cpu_scope: RUSAGE_SELF: lifecycle collector only, excludes guest runner date/awk children
